title: Conveyancing Assistant - Flexible working 1 office day per week.
description:
Conveyancing Assistant - Flexible working 1 office day per week. If you are confident with the required duties of a conveyancing support role and are looking for flexibility this is an ongoing assignment offering long term opportunity. Supporting one fee earner the roe will include:
- Opening new client files on the system
- Post exchange work including setting up completion documentation and liaising with mortgage lenders to ensure timely release of funds and redemption figures
- Post completion work including post completion letters to solicitors and clients, stampings and registrations with HMRC, submission of land registry applications and file closures including account balances Liaising with head office, clients, other solicitors, lenders and estate agents throughout the conveyancing process

Skills and Experience for applications:

This would suit an experienced conveyancing secretary, assistant or paralegal who is familiar with the duties described. Must be able to calmly, confidently and professionally communicate with all involved parties during transactions to ensure client satisfaction and comfortable to work independently/with minimum guidance and to provide some degree of holiday cover when necessary

Training on internal systems will be provided Remote working 4 days a week with 1 day per week in the office. If you would like to find out more please apply with a current CV for a confidential chat.

title: Legal Assistant Commercial Property
description:
Legal Assistant or Graduate opportunity for a keen individual looking to build their legal career path. If you are looking to join a supportive and progressive firm and gain valuable experience I would be pleased to hear from you.

Based in the Commercial Property team you will receive full training to be able to support the Fee Earners at the same time developing your own experience.

Duties will include:

Deal primarily with opening new files, scanning/photocopying, ordering legal searches, SDLT and Land Registry applications, closing files and general administration/preparing letters etc.

Provide support (virtually) to other offices where capacity allows as directed.

Take telephone calls on behalf of the fee earners and convey messages in a timely manner.

To arrange appointments as required.

To keep work up-to-date adopting the oldest/most urgent first principle.

To ensure efficient information recorded on the appropriate file management system.

If you have good keyboard, organisational skills and attention to detail please apply with a current CV.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Our client, a very reputable firm are looking to appoint a Legal Secretary based locally to Bourne. You will be tasked with providing secretarial support and assistance. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated and experienced secretary to play a key role in assisting our client of expert legal personnel within a friendly and supportive team environment.

To be considered for the role, you'll require the following essentials:
- Experience of working within the Legal Sector as a Secretary
- Proven audiotyping experience
- Knowledge of MS Office & Case Management Systems
- Excellent communication skills - both written & verbal
- Strong organisational skills
- High attention to detail

Within this position, you'll also be:
- Audio & copy typing, emailing, photocopying, filing of letters, emails and documents
- Completing forms and drafting documents
- Assisting with the preparation of court bundles
- Opening & closing of client files
- Running, managing & maintaining files on a case management system and following file procedures
- Speaking to clients and professional contacts, personally and by telephone, answering queries, giving information and making appointments
- Handling initial client enquiries
- Arranging of appointments & managing fee earners diaries
- Attending team meetings as required
- Covering reception as required

Salary & Working Hours

Salary is £24,000 - £29,000 per annum, dependant on experience

Working Hours are Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm with 1 hours' lunch

Talk Staff Recruitment is an established division of Talk Staff Group and works with companies throughout the East Midlands and UK with roles including many areas such as: Accountancy & Finance, Human Resources, Marketing, Contact Centre and Office Support.

Talk Staff Recruitment act as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Trainee Legal Secretary
description:
Trainee Legal Secretary

Spalding

We are delighted to be working with a highly regarded national law firm on the appointment of a Trainee Float Team Legal Secretary to join their busy Spalding office.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to begin or develop their career within the legal sector, offering the chance to gain valuable experience across a variety of legal departments within an established and respected firm.

The Opportunity

If you enjoy variety, like staying busy and are keen to learn, this could be the perfect role for you.

As a Trainee Float Team Legal Secretary, you will spend time supporting different legal departments across the office, providing essential secretarial and administrative assistance to fee earners and wider teams. With exposure to different areas of law, no two days will be the same, giving you the opportunity to develop a broad skill set and gain an insight into how a busy legal practice operates.

You will play an important role in helping the teams run efficiently, ensuring that administrative tasks are completed accurately and that clients receive a professional and helpful service.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties will include:
- Providing secretarial and administrative support across a range of legal departments
- Preparing, formatting and amending correspondence and legal documents
- Managing incoming and outgoing communications, including telephone calls and emails
- Assisting with document management, filing and maintaining accurate records
- Supporting diary management, appointments and general departmental administration
- Helping to ensure client information and documentation are handled professionally and confidentially
- Working collaboratively with solicitors, fee earners and colleagues across the office
- Learning new processes and adapting to the requirements of different teams

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised and proactive individual who is keen to learn and enjoys working in a varied, fast-paced environment.

You will ideally have:
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- A professional and friendly telephone manner
- Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively
- A flexible approach and the willingness to support different teams as required
- A positive attitude, eagerness to learn and a genuine interest in developing a career within the legal sector
- The ability to work well both independently and as part of a team

Previous legal secretarial experience would be beneficial, but a willingness to learn, a positive attitude and a strong work ethic are equally important.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience within a professional legal environment while developing the skills and confidence needed to build a career in legal administration.

The float team structure offers exposure to multiple legal departments, allowing you to broaden your knowledge, learn from experienced professionals and discover different areas of the legal sector.

If you are looking for a role that offers variety, development and the opportunity to become a valued member of a busy team, this could be an excellent next step.

Interested?

If you are organised, enthusiastic and looking for an opportunity to start or develop your career as a Legal Secretary in Spalding, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

title: Trainee Legal Secretary
description:
Trainee Legal Secretary

Spalding

Full-time Permanent

£25,000 - £27,000

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity has arisen to join as a Trainee Float Legal Secretary based in the Spalding office. This varied role offers the chance to support multiple departments across the firm, making it ideal for an organised and adaptable secretary or administrator who enjoys a diverse workload.

No previous Legal Secretary experience is required, full training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide high-quality secretarial and administrative support across a variety of legal departments.
- Prepare, format and amend legal documents, correspondence and reports.
- Manage diaries, appointments and meetings for fee earners.
- Handle telephone and email enquiries professionally and efficiently.
- Open, maintain and close client files in line with firm procedures.
- Assist with digital filing, document management, scanning and general office administration.
- Support billing, file management and other administrative tasks as required.
- Adapt quickly to different teams, priorities and workloads.
- Deliver excellent client service while maintaining confidentiality at all times.

About You

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, flexible and enjoys working in a fast-paced professional environment.

You will have:
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- The ability to manage changing priorities and work across multiple teams.
- A positive, proactive and adaptable approach.
- Previous Administrative experience is desirable.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £25,000 - £27,000 depending on experience.
- Full training and ongoing development.
- A varied role supporting multiple legal departments.
- A supportive, collaborative working environment.
- Excellent opportunities for career progression within a leading regional law firm.
